scope: non-exhaustive screening of original stability studies; NOT a validated dataset

definitions.lot_holdout: Entire independent manufacturing lots segregated from training; none verified in this screen
definitions.technical_replicate: Repeat analytical injections/aliquots are not new independent lots

sources.product: Sandoz naloxone hydrochloride injection 0.4 mg/mL, 1 mL ampoule
sources.independence: single named manufacturing lot; number of physical ampoules per arm/timepoint unconfirmed; HPLC injections are technical repeats
exposures: 80 C for 8 h then room temperature for 16 h daily
-20 C for 16 h then 4 C for 8 h daily
sources.status: conditional: one-lot condition-time-series, not multi-lot predictive dataset

sources.product: expired EpiPen and Jext 0.3 mg adrenaline auto-injectors
sources.independence: 24 devices total, 12 of each brand; 3 per brand per freeze-thaw-count arm; lot IDs not documented in table
exposures: 0,1,5,15 freeze-thaw cycles at -80 C then room temperature
sources.underlying_data: device-level expelled-mass table published; not transcribed here
sources.status: device-performance counterevidence; not chemical potency time series
flags: no potency, sterility or tissue delivery endpoint

sources.product: in-date epinephrine auto-injectors; brand/formulation not confirmed from abstract
sources.independence: 25 total, per-arm counts and independent lots absent from abstract
exposures: constant or cyclic 70 C for 5 or 10 days
measured_endpoints: epinephrine content of expelled solution by HPLC-UV
sources.status: thermal endpoint contrasts; no per-device repeated-time series established

sources.product: compounded epinephrine 25/50/100 microgram/mL in 5% dextrose infusion bags

sources.product: naloxone nasal spray device, exact product and lot need original full text

sources.status: single terminal device endpoint; not potency-time series

sources.product: expired nasal spray and injection naloxone; formulations and lot details not confirmed from abstract
